svg.title: How the Council is meant to work
svg.desc: How the Council is meant to work, on one real case from 11 November 2026. This is the design, not a working product; no model is trained yet. One: an agent hands in work, saying "README preview is ready for your review". Two: the Council catches the slop: the preview is ringed in red and stamped "sent back", because a newer version had already replaced this one. Three: it goes back with my feedback, "this is the old version". Other lines I keep repeating to agents: "I already said this yesterday" and "where is the source for that number?". Only the fixed work reaches me. What happened on 11 November 2026: this preview reached me. Catching it first is what the Council is being built to do.
